per_question.answer: Employees are entitled to 22 days of paid annual leave per leave year.

context.text:
Annual Leave Entitlement
Annual Leave Entitlement
Full-time employees are entitled to 22 days of paid annual leave per leave
year, accruing at approximately 1.83 days per month of service. This Leave
Policy is the authoritative source for leave entitlements and supersedes any
summary in other documents.

Sick Leave
Sick Leave
Employees are entitled to 12 paid sick days per year. A medical certificate is
required for any absence longer than three consecutive working days. Sick
leave does not carry over between years.

Paid Time Off
Paid Time Off
Employees receive 18 days of paid time off per calendar year, accruing at
1.5 days per month. Unused days may be carried over, subject to the detailed
rules in the Leave Policy document. Public holidays are published annually and
do not count against paid time off.

Parental Leave
Parental Leave
Primary caregivers are entitled to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.
Secondary caregivers are entitled to 4 weeks of fully paid parental leave,
which may be taken in blocks of no less than one week within 12 months of the
child's arrival.

Carryover
Carryover
A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the next
leave year. Carried-over days must be used before 31 March of the following
year, after which they expire.

Incident Reporting
Incident Reporting
Suspected security incidents, lost devices, or phishing messages must be
reported to security@acme.test within 24 hours of discovery. Do not attempt to
investigate or contain incidents yourself unless you are part of the Security
Operations team.

Escalation and Help
Escalation and Help
For HR questions contact People Operations through the HR portal. For equipment or access problems use the IT helpdesk. Security incidents follow the reporting duties in the Security Policy and must be reported within 24 hours.

Security Requirements
Security Requirements
Remote workers must connect through the corporate VPN for all work involving
internal systems. Personal printers may not be used for company documents.
Devices must remain locked when unattended, and screens must not be visible
from public spaces. See the Security Policy for incident reporting duties.

Anti-Bribery and Compliance
Anti-Bribery and Compliance
Acme Corp complies with all applicable anti-bribery laws. No employee may
offer, give, or authorize any payment or gift intended to improperly influence
a business decision. Suspected violations must be reported through the
anonymous ethics hotline.

Software Requests
Software Requests
Only software from the approved catalog may be installed on corporate devices.
Requests for new software are submitted through the IT portal and are reviewed
for security and licensing compliance within 10 working days. Installing
unapproved software violates the Security Policy.

Vendor Guidelines
These guidelines define how Acme Corp selects, onboards, and manages vendors. They apply to all
contracts above 5,000 USD in annual value. Vendor Registration
Prospective vendors must register in the procurement portal, provide a W-9 or equivalent tax form,
certificates of insurance, and two customer references. Registration review takes up to 15 working
days. Security Assessment
All vendors handling Confidential or Restricted data must complete a security questionnaire and pass a
third-party risk assessment before contract signature. Vendors with system access must sign the Data
Processing Addendum and enforce multi-factor authentication for all named accounts. Payment Terms
Standard payment terms are net 45 days from invoice receipt. Invoices must reference a purchase
order number; invoices without one are returned. Early-payment discounts of 2 percent or more are
automatically accepted by Accounts Payable. Gifts and Hospitality
Vendors may not offer gifts above 50 USD to any employee. Invitations to vendor-hosted events must
be approved by Compliance in advance. This mirrors the employee obligations in the Employee
Handbook.

Third-Party Access
Third-Party Access
Vendors requiring system access must sign the standard Data Processing
Addendum, use named accounts with multi-factor authentication, and undergo
quarterly access reviews by the Security team.

Code of Conduct
Code of Conduct
All employees are expected to act with integrity, respect, and professionalism.
Harassment, discrimination, and retaliation are strictly prohibited and are
grounds for disciplinary action up to and including termination. Gifts from
vendors above 50 USD must be declined or reported to Compliance.

Multi-Factor Authentication
Multi-Factor Authentication
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all corporate accounts. Hardware
security keys are issued to engineers with production access. SMS-based
factors are not accepted for privileged accounts.
